lesson: Altamira is a neighborhood within Chacao, but the resolution used the finer-grained label. For open location questions, match the likely incident bulletin's neighborhood or locality granularity rather than relying only on the broader municipality named in the criteria.

The host prior was too narrowly concentrated on established Gulf and Morocco tournament hosts. New youth-format events can be awarded to emerging federation partners such as Azerbaijan, so future host-country slates should preserve wider federation and regional coverage until an official leak appears.

The negotiating text named Hamas's armed wing, the Qassam Brigades, rather than the parent organization. When the criteria demand the official name as stated in a text, forecast the named operational subgroup and include parent-body wording only as a hedge.

The seismic base-rate slate missed inland Yaracuy. For highly specific future-event locations without direct signals, spread coverage across distinct seismic zones rather than clustering most probability in the historically most active western and coastal states.
